links.outcome: Resident diagnostic accuracy and reporting time with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Diagnostic accuracy improved from 85.55 to 90.34% (p < 0.05) and reporting time fell from 153.93 to 108.08 s (p < 0.001); AI-generated reports rated slightly lower than manual (4.12 vs. 4.38, p < 0.01).
links.quote: InterpreFFA significantly improved diagnostic accuracy (85.55 to 90.34%, p < 0.05) and shortened reporting time (153.93 to 108.08 s, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of an AI report-generation tool on resident ophthalmologists' diagnostic accuracy and reporting time in a simulated clinical setting.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinical reporting vs unassisted reporting
